_comment: Pinned by step 5 of 4.5c.7-anchor on Sepolia. The test test_verify_anchor_on_chain_sepolia loads this file, fetches the tx via ETH_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL, and asserts the tx's calldata bytes equal expected_root_hex. The tx is immutable on-chain; this fixture is therefore a permanent regression assertion against real Ethereum. The Merkle root anchored here is the same one tests/fixtures/anchor_inclusion.json's expected_merkle_root_hex declares, so passing this test simultaneously proves the verifier's RPC path AND the cross-implementation Merkle equivalence with the FidesChain backend.
